topic: A person learns their childhood best friend doesn't remember them
text: I can't believe it. After all those years, after all the secrets we shared, the schemes we hatched, the backs we had each other's on, this is what I get? A blank stare, a polite chuckle when I mention the times we spent together. It's like they're treating the best parts of my childhood as if they never existed. How can someone just forget, just erase all that history? It’s not a small thing, what we had. It’s not something you just lose like an old toy. But here we are, and I’m left holding on to memories that, for him, never even happened. Great. Just great.
